transit_tip: Start at Seoul Forest Station and finish near Seongsu Station to avoid backtracking. Check pop-up reservation requirements before arrival.
tourist_trap_warning: Do not build the entire day around one viral pop-up; entry queues and temporary closures can consume several hours.

transit_tip: Use Hongik University Station exits serving Yeonnam for the park, then walk south toward the main Hongdae streets.
tourist_trap_warning: Avoid assuming every street performance or club is free; check admission, drink and re-entry rules first.

transit_tip: Samseong Station and Bongeunsa Station serve opposite sides of the complex; choose the exit nearest your first stop.
tourist_trap_warning: Do not schedule an unfamiliar cosmetic procedure immediately before a flight, concert or important event.

transit_tip: Use Myeongdong Station for the shopping core and Euljiro 1-ga or Euljiro 3-ga for the later dining segment.
tourist_trap_warning: Compare product prices before buying multi-item skincare bundles and confirm any tourist refund at checkout.

transit_tip: Begin at Gyeongbokgung Station and continue mainly on foot toward Bukchon, Anguk, Insadong and Ikseon-dong.
tourist_trap_warning: Bukchon is a residential area; observe restricted visiting hours, keep voices low and avoid photographing residents.

transit_tip: Haeundae and Gwangalli are not adjacent; allow sufficient subway or taxi time between the two coastal districts.
tourist_trap_warning: Do not rely on the final subway without checking the current schedule, especially after waterfront events or drone shows.

transit_tip: Jeonpo Station is convenient for the café district, while Seomyeon Station provides the main transfer and late-evening transport options.
tourist_trap_warning: Popular restaurants can have Korean-language queue systems; confirm whether walk-in registration requires a local phone number.

key_highlights: Local seafood or black pork meal
transit_tip: A rental car offers the most flexibility; bus travelers should choose fewer stops and verify the last return bus in advance.
tourist_trap_warning: A café may be popular for its view rather than its food; check menu prices and minimum-order rules before joining a long queue.

key_highlights: Forest or museum alternative in poor weather
transit_tip: Check wind and weather before departure. Without a rental car, keep the route compact because east-coast bus intervals can lengthen total travel time.
tourist_trap_warning: Do not attempt sunrise, multiple distant attractions and a same-day airport transfer without substantial schedule buffers.
